description: A merchant's PLA performance (os_ads_search + smart_shopping performance campaigns only) broken down by product category (e_product_type) x campaign for a marketplace over a period, one row per category x campaign x os_client_id. Attributes: category, campaign_name, marketing_campaign_id, marketing_campaign_group_id, os_client_id. Metrics: spend, impressions, clicks, orders, revenue. Filter by os_client_id (required) to scope to specific merchants. spend and revenue are raw (not currency-converted); ctr/cpc/cpm/roas are derived downstream from these raw aggregates.

category.selector: CASE WHEN mmpd.e_product_type IS NULL OR mmpd.e_product_type = '' OR LOWER(mmpd.e_product_type) = 'na' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE mmpd.e_product_type END
category.description: Product-type / category of the advertised SKUs (e_product_type); NULL/empty/'na' collapse to 'Unknown'.

marketing_campaign_id.description: Marketing campaign id (working id for internal analysis).

marketing_campaign_group_id.description: Marketing campaign group id (working id for internal analysis).

os_client_id.description: OnlineSales client id of the merchant (working id for internal analysis). Filter by this to scope to specific merchants (required).

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.cost ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: PLA ad spend for this category x campaign (raw cost, not currency-converted).

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
impressions.description: PLA ad impressions for this category x campaign.

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)
clicks.description: PLA ad clicks for this category x campaign.

orders.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.program_per_click_timestamp_conversions ELSE 0 END), 0)
orders.description: Ad-attributed orders / conversions (per-click-timestamp) for this category x campaign.

revenue.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.program_per_click_timestamp_sales ELSE 0 END), 0)
revenue.description: Ad-attributed sales / GMV (per-click-timestamp) for this category x campaign (raw, not currency-converted).

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.merchant_merchandise_product_dimensions` AS mmpd JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_product_ads_device_product_facts` AS f ON f.client_id = mmpd.client_id AND f.sku_id = mmpd.sku_id LEFT JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.campaign_tagging_data` AS ctd ON ctd.account_id = f.account_id AND ctd.campaign_id = f.campaign_id AND ctd.client_id = f.client_id JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions` AS mcd ON ctd.marketing_campaign_id = mcd.marketing_campaign_id AND mcd.client_id = f.client_id AND mcd.campaign_origin != 'PACKAGE_BASED' JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketing_campaign_group_dimensions` AS mcgd ON ctd.client_id = mcgd.client_id AND ctd.marketing_campaign_group_id = mcgd.marketing_campaign_group_id JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.clients` AS c ON c.client_id = f.client_id WHERE c.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND f.date >= '__START_DATE_1__' AND f.date <= '__END_DATE_1__' AND LOWER(mcgd.campaign_type) IN ('performance') AND LOWER(mcgd.campaign_subtype) IN ('os_ads_search', 'smart_shopping') AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
